segments.comment: A levitating Samurai wishes for lava against the west wall of a closet room, steps east, and fills the rest of the level with 1000 peaceful newts. A sleeping bat created on the lava is polymorphed into a red mold under monpolycontrol. A red mold cannot move, so mon.c m_calcdistress() calls minliquid() at the end of the turn: the mold burns slightly, rloc() fails on the full level, and deal_with_overcrowding() moves it into limbo. Seed, clock, character and keys were chosen for this path.
